annotation.bound_parties_text: The employer must ensure machinery and equipment is safeguarded; owners of roll-on/roll-off containers and employers must inspect and keep records; workers, operators and qualified persons are also bound.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Unless elsewhere provided for in this Occupational Health and Safety Regulation, the employer must ensure that machinery and equipment is fitted with adequate safeguards
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 12.83 Industrial robots ... [Amended by B.C. Reg. 312/2003, effective October 29, 2003.]
